answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, expired if not renewed by fresh work, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. What survives to the jetty is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Each submission hangs on the wander of a task receipt, and the raven is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
